description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thirunelvely North Conter, Nallur D/S Division, Jaffna  District - Cad Map No. 910001
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in the Jaffna district. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, owners, and encumbrances, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
